johannes.description: It was a real pleasure working with Yunus during our time at Microsoft MSN / News. He brought a friendly, steady energy to every project, even when we were dealing with fires behind the scenes. I always appreciated how patient and solution-oriented he was. You could rely on him to stay calm, cut through the noise, and get us moving again. We tackled plenty of technical challenges together, including building new experiences like tipping and subscriptions. Yunus consistently found fast, effective ways to solve complex problems at scale for millions of users across many international markets. I'm grateful for the time we worked together and would happily collaborate with him again.

riza.description: As Yunus's team leader at Microsoft, I watched him grow into an exceptional frontend developer. His eagerness to learn and ability to quickly grasp complex concepts was remarkable. He brought both technical excellence and a positive attitude to our team.

alp.description:
Yunus is one of the rare engineers who can build complete, production-ready web applications by writing clean, correct code directly in a simple editor and delivering error-free results.

During my time as a Lead Engineer at Microsoft, we assigned Yunus ownership of ten separate web experiences that were originally planned as a one-month effort. While the rest of the team was still preparing the roadmap, Yunus completed all ten in a single weekend—driven purely by passion and craftsmanship. This significantly accelerated our overall delivery.

Over the following years, I had the opportunity to work with him across multiple backend systems and payment platforms. Even while mentoring and growing junior developers, he consistently maintained the same energy, curiosity, and execution speed he showed on day one. The products and components he designed continue to be used by over 1 billion users at Microsoft.

Yunus is an exceptional engineer with rare execution ability, deep technical intuition, and a genuine passion for building high-quality systems at scale.

showcase.intro: Wondering how to get a website made without agency pricing? I build SEO-ready, mobile-first sites for local businesses — many delivered within a few days when content is ready. Live references and portfolio previews below.

seo.title: SEO built in
seo.body: Semantic headings, meta tags, performance, FAQ-style content, and local signals (address, hours, contact) — like my work on Dokuma Kuyumculuk and Sistem Teknik.

budget.title: Low-budget friendly
budget.body: Focused scope: the pages that matter (home, services, contact, FAQs). No bloated CMS fees — modern Next.js you can grow over time.

speed.title: Fast delivery
speed.body: When your copy and assets are ready, many brochure sites can go live within a few days. You get a clear delivery date before work starts.

mobile.title: Mobile-first
mobile.body: Most local customers find you on a phone. Layouts, tap targets, and WhatsApp/phone CTAs are first-class.

showcase.sitesSubtitle: Live client sites and hosted portfolio demos — open in a new tab to explore structure, speed, and SEO.

contact.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'd like an affordable business website.

howTo.q: How do I get a website made?
howTo.a: Email hello@yunusemreuveyik.com with your business name, services, and any logo or copy you have. We'll agree on pages, I'll send an affordable quote and delivery timeline.

affordable.q: Can you build a cheap or affordable business website?
affordable.a: Yes — focused scope instead of agency bundles: home, services, contact, FAQs. You don't pay for features you won't use; price is fixed once scope is clear.

delivery.q: How fast can my site go live?
delivery.a: If content is ready, many small-business sites can launch within a few days. Bilingual TR/EN or extra pages add time; you get a firm date before we start.

who.a: Shops, trades, and service companies that need a credible web presence and local search visibility — not a six-figure custom platform on day one.

seo.q: Will my site rank on Google?
seo.a: No one can guarantee rankings, but I implement technical SEO and content patterns that help local queries — structured FAQs, clear titles, fast loads, and proper metadata.

stack.a: Next.js, React, and TypeScript — the same stack I use in senior product roles. Optional Turkish/English like dokumakuyumculuk.com.

contact.a: A short email is enough: your industry, target customers, sites you like. I'll reply with a simple roadmap and quote.
